title: In Her Own Words: Trish Banister’s leap into staffing
summary: According to recent industry estimates, women own or co-own more than 30% of all U.S. franchises in virtually every industry imaginable.
body_markdown:
According to recent industry estimates, women own or co-own more than 30% of all U.S. franchises in virtually every industry imaginable. So it shouldn’t be surprising that Trish Banister (Franchise Owner, Snelling, Ft. Collins, Colorado) found a second career as owner of a staffing franchise, but it was to her.


*“For women considering a leap of their own, always trust your instincts and never underestimate the power of the village around you.”*
